description: The TileLang kernel tests of vLLM patch 0027, run from the TP4 candidate image's own vLLM tree against torch references: sparse MLA at 16, 24 and 64 heads (TP4, TP3, TP1 per rank), MXFP4 query quantization and index-key writes, the indexers and exact top-k, MXFP8 GEMMs with K blocks of 128, 192 and 64, the BF16 GEMM, RMSNorm, and the routed experts at 256-, 576- and 320-wide expert rows.
